subject.title: [Security] XSS vulnerability in plugin metadata rendering within Control UI

question: Should this report be routed through OpenClaw's private security process while a minimal malicious-plugin reproduction is obtained?
rationale: The claimed impact crosses the administrator-browser trust boundary, but the public report currently lacks enough exploit detail to validate or safely dismiss it.

options.title: Route privately and reproduce
options.body: Keep the issue open with minimal public detail while a trusted reviewer constructs a malicious manifest and traces the exact client-side sink.

options.title: Request public reproduction
options.body: Ask the reporter for a minimal plugin, exact UI navigation, browser version, and redacted console or recording evidence before further triage.

recommendation.title: Route privately and reproduce
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open with minimal public detail while a trusted reviewer constructs a malicious manifest and traces the exact client-side sink.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to the introduction of the Control UI surface, while exact current-path ownership remains uncertain.
